snippet.title: Rise of Robots // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/2375810/Rise_of_Robots

Rise of Robots is a Roguelite Shooter where you build a powerful weapon as you fight to survive ever increasing swarms of robots. Stack powerups to create a unique weapon each run and beat the challenge on each map

Developed by
Fyn Games
